name: King Soopers Grocery Distribution Center Aurora CO

fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (Tower Rd pano, 2023-05) shows a controlled gate: brick guard booth between channelized lanes, STOP signs both directions, yellow jersey-barrier islands forming a checkpoint pinch-point.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Brick masonry guard house with wraparound windows, peaked roof and a camera/comms mast on top, set between the in and out lanes at the Tower Rd entrance. Clearly a staffed booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed guard shack is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard between the gate and the dock faces gives ample interior queue room before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep interior approach from the gate across the campus apron easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single gate complex on Tower Rd handles both directions (booth flanked by an in lane and an out lane).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: ~1 inbound lane at the booth from overhead + Street View; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and multiple barrier-defined lanes leave room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple full-size DC buildings each with long banks of dock doors on opposing faces; campus total well into the hundreds -> 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yards along Tower Rd and between buildings hold many bobtail-dropped trailers -> 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on opposite faces of the large DC buildings indicate physically separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 4 large DC buildings (north automated DC w/ rooftop solar, central DC, the very long south DC, plus a smaller warehouse) under one fenced King Soopers/Kroger operation.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots full of parked trailers separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A through rail corridor runs along the north edge but no spur enters any building; marked false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Denver-Aurora metro; residential and industrial development on all sides.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~102 acres from the traced perimeter polygon enclosing all four DC buildings and their yards.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Only one Street View pano exists within range (Tower Rd at the gate, 39.74490,-104.77424, captured 2023-05); used for both perimeter and truckGate with computed headings.

citations.claim: Kroger corporate logistics page lists King Soopers DC at 1933 Tower Road, Aurora CO 80011 with active work-in line.

verification.rationale: Kroger logistics page lists Aurora King Soopers DC by exact address; closures were CO retail stores, not this DC.
